title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.28.0 flags deprecated Kotlin symbols with a strikethrough and shows the suggested replacement code directly on hover.

highlights.title: Deprecation Strikethrough
highlights.description: Deprecated Kotlin symbols now render with a strikethrough directly in the editor, so outdated APIs are visible at a glance instead of requiring a lookup.

highlights.title: ReplaceWith Hover Snippet
highlights.description: Hovering a deprecated symbol shows the suggested replacement code from its ReplaceWith annotation, so you can migrate off it without opening the declaration.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Added strikethrough rendering for deprecated Kotlin symbols, making outdated APIs visible at a glance instead of requiring a manual check.
Added a hover tooltip on deprecated symbols that shows the ReplaceWith snippet, so the suggested replacement is visible without navigating to the declaration.
Available in both desktop VS Code and VS Code for the Web.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No other functional changes in this release.
